earlyReleaseCohort.definition: Films entering cinema in the first 78 career weeks, observed through each career horizon or ending; incomplete runs remain censored

definitions.recoupment: Theatrical producer receipts cover production, campaign, booking and paid backend; investor ownership distributions excluded
definitions.financialHit: Theatrical project profit is at least 60% of production budget, matching the normal NPC financial-hit hurdle
definitions.nearBreakEven: Absolute profit or deficit within 5% of total modeled paid costs; exact deficits remain deficits
definitions.billionAttainment: Measured public gross crossed the threshold; recent open films can still grow, so attainment is not a final lifetime probability

limitations: Fixed sustainable actor policies over four early careers, not every career path or a universal player-wide probability
All-completed rates can favor short runs; the first-78-weeks release cohort is provided as a follow-up check
Company/title identities can recur across seeded worlds; observations are correlated, so no independent-binomial confidence interval is claimed
Future streaming, soundtrack and merchandise receipts are excluded from theatrical results; a theater loss is not a final all-media loss
Prepared established-owner attainability cases are excluded from these normal-career rates
